symbols.label: ComputeTime
symbols.description: Extracts a runtime benchmark result from the passed Explanation.

symbols.label: ExplanationError
symbols.description: A measure of the explanation error relative to a model's actual output.

symbols.label: BenchmarkResult
symbols.description: The result of a benchmark run.

symbols.label: SequentialMasker
symbols.description: Benchmark class that sequentially masks input features (by sort order and perturbation type) to compute removal curves for a model.

symbols.label: SequentialPerturbation
symbols.description: Benchmark class that perturbs features sequentially and scores the model's dependence on each feature to build removal curves.

symbols.label: experiments()
symbols.description: Benchmark-suite iterator: yields (dataset, model, method, metric) experiment tuples, optionally filtered by argument.

symbols.label: run_experiment()
symbols.description: Runs a single benchmark experiment (dataset, model, method, metric) and returns its scores, with optional pickle caching.

symbols.label: run_experiments_helper()
symbols.description: Worker helper that unpacks an (experiment, cache_dir) tuple and runs run_experiment, for parallel execution.

symbols.label: run_experiments()
symbols.description: Runs the benchmark experiments for the given filters, optionally in parallel, and returns (experiment, score) pairs.

symbols.label: run_remote_experiments()
symbols.description: Use ssh to run the experiments on remote machines in parallel.

symbols.label: update()
symbols.description: Benchmark helper that runs a sequential-perturbation removal curve and records the (xs, ys, auc) result under the given metric key.

symbols.label: get_benchmark()
symbols.description: Benchmark helper that evaluates a list of metrics against a model and its attributions, returning per-metric scores.

symbols.label: get_metrics()
symbols.description: Benchmark helper that selects the set of metrics shared across (or unioned from) the given benchmark results.

symbols.label: trend_plot()
symbols.description: Benchmark plotting helper: plots the performance-vs-feature-count trend curve for each metric in the results.

symbols.label: compare_plot()
symbols.description: Benchmark plotting helper: side-by-side comparison of explainer methods across shared metrics.

symbols.label: remove_retrain()
symbols.description: The model is retrained for each test sample with the important features set to a constant.

symbols.label: remove_mask()
symbols.description: Each test sample is masked by setting the important features to a constant.

symbols.label: remove_impute()
symbols.description: The model is reevaluated for each test sample with the important features set to an imputed value.

symbols.label: remove_resample()
symbols.description: The model is reevaluated for each test sample with the important features set to resample background values.

symbols.label: batch_remove_retrain()
symbols.description: An approximation of holdout that only retraines the model once.

symbols.label: keep_retrain()
symbols.description: The model is retrained for each test sample with the non-important features set to a constant.

symbols.label: keep_mask()
symbols.description: The model is reevaluated for each test sample with the non-important features set to their mean.

symbols.label: keep_impute()
symbols.description: The model is reevaluated for each test sample with the non-important features set to an imputed value.

symbols.label: keep_resample()
symbols.description: The model is reevaluated for each test sample with the non-important features set to resample background values.

symbols.label: batch_keep_retrain()
symbols.description: An approximation of keep that only retraines the model once.

symbols.label: local_accuracy()
symbols.description: The how well do the features plus a constant base rate sum up to the model output.

symbols.label: to_array()
symbols.description: Benchmark helper that converts any pandas DataFrame arguments to numpy arrays.

symbols.label: const_rand()
symbols.description: Generate a random array with a fixed seed.

symbols.label: const_shuffle()
symbols.description: Shuffle an array in-place with a fixed seed.

symbols.label: strip_list()
symbols.description: This assumes that if you have a list of outputs you just want the second one (the second class is the '1' class).

symbols.label: random()
symbols.description: Benchmark method: returns attributions from a random (baseline) explainer as a comparison reference.

symbols.label: sampling_shap_1000()
symbols.description: Benchmark method: SHAP values from the SamplingExplainer using 1000 samples.

symbols.label: saabas()
symbols.description: Benchmark method: SHAP values with the Saabas (tree path-dependent) approximation via TreeExplainer(approximate=True).

symbols.label: maple()
symbols.description: Benchmark method: attributions from the MAPLE explainer (local linear approximations).

symbols.label: tree_maple()
symbols.description: Benchmark method: attributions from the Tree-MAPLE explainer (local linear approximations for tree ensembles).

symbols.label: KerasWrap
symbols.description: A wrapper that allows us to set parameters in the constructor and do a reset before fitting.

symbols.label: get_method_color()
symbols.description: Benchmark plotting helper: returns the plotting color declared in a benchmark method's docstring metadata.

symbols.label: get_method_linestyle()
symbols.description: Benchmark plotting helper: returns the line style declared in a benchmark method's docstring metadata.

symbols.label: get_metric_attr()
symbols.description: Benchmark plotting helper: extracts a declared attribute (e.g. transform) from a benchmark metric's docstring metadata.

symbols.label: plot_curve()
symbols.description: Benchmark plotting helper: runs the experiments for a dataset/model/metric and plots the performance curve per method.

symbols.label: plot_human()
symbols.description: Benchmark plotting helper: plots the human-annotation (decision-tree proxy) comparison for a metric.

symbols.label: make_grid()
symbols.description: Benchmark plotting helper: collects per-metric score data (with optional normalization or transform) into a grid for plotting.

symbols.label: plot_grids()
symbols.description: Benchmark plotting helper: runs the experiments for a dataset and a list of models and renders the full HTML grid of result plots.

symbols.label: MAPLE
symbols.description: shap MAPLE explainer alias: model-agnostic local explanations (the Maple class lives in explainers/other/_maple.py; the top-level MAPLE binding mirrors it).
